title: 고등교육기관의 자체평가에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Definition of Self-Evaluation)
"Self-evaluation" means a school's comprehensive inspection, analysis, and assessment of its overall operation, including education and research, organization and administration, and facilities and equipment (hereinafter referred to as "education and research, etc."), conducted by a school under Article 2 of the Higher Education Act (hereinafter referred to as a "school").
